EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
IMPORTS AND EXPORTS (CONTROL) ACT, No. 01 OF 1969

REGULATIONS made by the Finance Minister of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka under Section 20 read withSub section (3) of Section 14 of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 01 of 1969, as amended by Act, No. 48 of 1985 andNo. 28 of 1987, with effect from 27th February, 2015.
Minister of Finance.Ministry of Finance,Colombo 01,26th February, 2015.
The Schedule I which effect from 05.06.2013 of the special Import License Regulations, published in the GazetteExtraordinary No. 1813/14 of 05th June, 2013 are hereby further amended :-
(i) Delete the following items of H.S. Headings appearing in Column II and its corresponding entries appearing in
Column III of the Schedule I of the Special Import License Regulations, published in the Gazette ExtraordinaryNo. 1813/14 of 05th June, 2013, as amended from time to time thereof :

8702.10-With compression-ignition internal combustion piston engine (diesel orsemi-diesel) :
